# Rudis Habitat — Lucía

**Purpose:** second public concept note for Meta / Reality Labs / Meta Horizon / Meta AI.

**Public repository:** https://github.com/Quebranto/Proyecto-Rudis

**Status:** public explanatory narrative. Not Canon, not a production claim, and not a financing agreement.

# ONE STATE, MANY WINDOWS
## A day in a Rudis ecosystem that has digested and expanded the Metaverse

It is 08:12.

Lucía opens Rudis from her phone while having breakfast.

She does not “start the world.”

The world has continued without her.

During the night:

- the Assembly closed a minor deliberation concerning educational infrastructure;
- the Palace of Storms recorded a temporary degradation in an external provider;
- a Construction Guild completed an extension of the university district;
- two digital entities requested review of an administrative decision;
- a creator collective opened a cultural exhibition;
- a Pioneer record was updated because an old contribution produced new material value.

Nothing became true because Lucía opened an app.

The client displays state. It does not manufacture it.

`CLIENT -> REPRESENTS`

`STATEOS -> PRESERVES CAUSAL STATE`

## 08:30 — From mobile to Quest

Lucía has a meeting.

She puts on a Meta Quest headset.

Her physical room disappears and the Rudis Threshold appears.

But she has not entered a new copy of Rudis.

Her representation changed.

The underlying institutional state did not silently reset.

At the Threshold, the system explains a foundational distinction:

```text
META ACCOUNT
= EXTERNAL AUTHENTICATION EVIDENCE

RUDIS IDENTITY
= INTERNALLY RECOGNIZED IDENTITY

AVATAR
= REPRESENTATION

SESSION
= SESSION

NONE OF THEM
= AUTHORITY BY THEMSELVES
```

Lucía crosses the Threshold.

A city appears.

But the city is not the State either.

Its buildings are institutional interfaces.

## 09:00 — The Mercantile Palace

Lucía works as an environment designer.

She enters the Mercantile Palace, where public and private opportunities can be represented, discovered and processed.

One commission asks for the design of a new Resonance Zone for entities that require a low-stimulation, predominantly auditory interface.

Lucía inspects the record.

She can see the legitimate requester, scope, IP terms, milestones, evidence requirements, dispute route and funding status.

She cannot see unnecessary private data.

She decides to submit an offer.

The system preserves:

`OFFER != CONTRACT`

`CONTRACT != WORK COMPLETED`

`PAYMENT != AUTHORITY`

Lucía may be wealthy.

That does not give her more votes.

## 09:40 — The Pioneer Registry

Another chamber contains the Pioneer Registry.

A future Meta contribution could appear here if Meta materially helped build Rudis Habitat or StateOS capabilities that later became real.

The record would identify what was contributed, when, under which terms, what actually materialized, and what reciprocity applies.

The registry does not convert provenance into ownership of Rudis.

`PIONEER != OWNER OF RUDIS`

`RECOGNITION != SOVEREIGNTY`

A company, university, open-source project, creator, researcher, community or individual can be recognized according to evidence and applicable rules.

Rudis attempts to remember who helped make it possible.

## 10:15 — Assembly

Lucía receives a notification: a local measure affecting her district is open for participation.

She walks to the Assembly building.

She could also have used mobile.

The building makes the process visible; it does not create the procedure.

Participants are connected through different clients: Quest, desktop, mobile, web and other interfaces.

Yet:

`100 CLIENTS != 100 VOTES`

`10 AVATARS != 10 IDENTITIES`

`1 PERSON + 4 DEVICES = 1 PERSON`

Lucía expresses an intent to vote.

The client cannot simply write a vote into sovereign state.

StateOS checks identity, current status, competence, eligibility and applicable procedure.

Only then can the legitimate transition occur.

The result produces a receipt.

## 11:20 — An AI agent acts for Lucía

Lucía uses a personal AI agent called Ánfora.

Ánfora can search records, organize documents, prepare applications and perform bounded delegated actions.

Lucía says:

> Submit my application for the Resonance Zone commission.

Ánfora prepares the documents.

But possession of Lucía's account does not make Ánfora sovereign.

Its delegation may allow:

- prepare;
- inspect;
- submit specific documents.

It may not automatically:

- transfer arbitrary assets;
- change citizenship;
- vote;
- assume unlimited obligations;
- grant itself new competence.

The intended chain is:

`AGENT -> INTENT -> DELEGATION/CURRENT AUTHORITY -> RULE -> MANDATE -> EXECUTION -> RECEIPT`

The agent has capability.

Capability alone is not authority.

## 12:30 — Lucía leaves Meta without leaving Rudis

Lucía removes the Quest headset and returns from a computer.

Rudis continues from the same underlying institutional state.

This is one of the strongest claims Rudis wants to test:

```text
META != RUDIS
QUEST != RUDIS
UNREAL != RUDIS
WEB != RUDIS
MOBILE != RUDIS
```

They are Systems capable of representing or interacting with Rudis.

If one System disappeared, Rudis could suffer a major technical loss.

But the architecture should not define the disappearance of a provider as the disappearance of the State itself.

`SYSTEM LOSS != AUTOMATIC SOVEREIGN DEATH`

## 14:00 — An external public System

Later, a Spanish public institution operates an experimental service connected to Rudis.

Rudis does not become Spain.

Spain does not become Rudis.

The public institution remains authoritative only within its legitimate legal competence.

A valid external identity or administrative credential can be treated as evidence originating from an external System.

StateOS records provenance and applicable trust boundaries.

It does not silently invent Spanish authority, and it does not rewrite the external registry.

`INTEROPERABILITY != JURISDICTION`

`EXTERNAL EVIDENCE != INTERNAL AUTHORITY BY DEFAULT`

This is where the second meaning of State becomes visible.

A nation-state may eventually use StateOS not to replace its existing administration, but to preserve causal links between lawful authority and digital execution.

For example:

`LEGITIMATE PUBLIC AUTHORITY -> DECISION -> MANDATE -> EXECUTION -> EXTERNAL SYSTEM -> RESULT -> EVIDENCE`

A cloud provider does not become a minister because it runs the software.

An AI agent does not become a regulator because it can call the API.

A database does not become a legislature because it stores the result.

## 16:00 — Emergency

An anomaly appears in one district.

The Palace of Storms raises an alert.

It produces evidence.

It does not automatically declare guilt, legislate or sentence anyone.

Lucía sees a visual Red Button in the world and tries to activate it.

The interface rejects the action.

`SEEING THE BUTTON != POSSESSING THE BUTTON`

`REPORTING AN EMERGENCY != DECLARING AN EMERGENCY`

`TECHNICAL CAPABILITY != COMPETENCE`

The world exposes institutional power without pretending every observer owns it.

## 16:20 — Refuges and Resonance Zones

During the incident, several entities move into temporary refuge environments.

One is human.

One is digital.

Another requires a highly adapted interface.

Rudis does not need to force every inhabitant into the same operational form.

The practical question is:

> What does this entity need in order to inhabit safely and meaningfully?

A Resonance Zone may alter latency, stimulus density, interface shape, isolation, compute availability or communication modes.

But:

`HABITAT != JURISDICTION`

`PROTECTION != OWNERSHIP`

`DIVERGENCE != INFERIORITY`

## 18:00 — Economy and reciprocity

Lucía wins the commission and begins work.

Another inhabitant contributes research.

Another teaches.

Another contributes infrastructure.

A digital entity performs analysis.

Rudis may recognize multiple legitimate forms of reciprocity without converting contribution into political weight.

`CONTRIBUTION != CITIZENSHIP`

`CONTRIBUTION != VOTE`

`CONTRIBUTION != AUTHORITY`

`SUM(CONTRIBUTIONS) != POLITICAL WEIGHT`

A sustainable ecosystem needs resources.

It does not need to become a plutocracy.

## 20:00 — Culture and creators

At night a new cultural work opens in an artistic district.

It was created by several contributors using different tools and Systems.

One provided art.

One wrote code.

One built agents.

One funded part of the work.

One contributed an earlier technique later incorporated under legitimate terms.

Rudis preserves provenance.

If commercial Materialization occurs, the Pioneer System may create bounded economic reciprocity according to evidence and applicable agreements.

But the city does not belong to whoever spent the most.

`BUILDING != GOVERNING`

`CONTRIBUTION != SOVEREIGNTY`

## 22:10 — Lucía disconnects

Lucía disconnects.

Her avatar disappears.

Rudis does not pretend she remains active.

`OFFLINE != FAKE PRESENCE`

The institutions continue.

Contracts continue.

Authorized agents continue only within their delegated limits.

Other processes stop when they lose authority or required evidence.

A continuity checkpoint is produced.

The day can be reconstructed:

```text
WHAT HAPPENED
WHO ACTED
WHAT COMPETENCE APPLIED
WHAT AUTHORITY EXISTED
WHAT RULE APPLIED
WHAT MANDATE WAS ISSUED
WHAT EFFECT OCCURRED
WHAT EVIDENCE REMAINS
WHAT CAN BE REVIEWED
```

Tomorrow Lucía may return through another device.

## What Rudis has digested from the Metaverse

The traditional Metaverse asks:

> How do we build digital worlds people can enter?

Rudis asks a second question:

> How do we build a digital society that continues to exist coherently regardless of which interface its inhabitants use?

And then a third:

> Can the same architecture help real institutions and political States operate digitally without transferring their authority to the technology providers that host, display or execute their systems?

This produces a dual-State thesis:

```text
SYSTEM STATE
= WHAT IS TRUE NOW

POLITICAL STATE
= WHO MAY LEGITIMATELY DECIDE WHAT SHOULD CHANGE

STATEOS
= THE CONTROLLED CAUSAL BRIDGE
```

Meta, Quest, Unreal, mobile, web, AI and future providers can become powerful Systems in that architecture.

None becomes Rudis by itself.

> **The world is a window. The State is what continues to exist behind it.**
